sources.ref: WebHID identity of a Qudelix-5K, read with the eqcaps inspector

meta.notes: Seeded from AutoEQ by scripts/import/seed.ts. Band count, gain range and peaking Q range from AutoEQ's PEQ_CONFIGS QUDELIX_5K, which is an optimizer setting: the engine may allow more bands. The frequency range and the shelves' Q range are assumptions. USB identity from a devicePEQ recorded capture. Steps are the USB write's resolution (freq 1 Hz, gain 0.1 dB, Q 1/1024), with Q's minimum moved onto that grid (corrected 2026-10-02). The second USB identity (0x4007, "Qudelix-5K USB DAC") is a maintainer's unit, added 2026-10-03; devicePEQ's capture has 0x4005 "... 48KHz". 0x0a12 is the Bluetooth chip vendor's id, shared with other devices (FiiO's among them), so the vendor alone says nothing.
